purpose: Self-contained verified re-export of already-existing authentic clean historical records.
counting_note: Counts are native record counts, including distinct command execution and tool-result records; not counts of unique logical commands.
field_identity: Each retained JSONL record text exactly matches its corresponding prior-export JSONL record. All retained payload values equal their native source values except the explicitly normalized command type described below. Native source-line hashes retain original line ending bytes.

command_type_normalization.purpose: Prior exporter schema label; not a verbatim native type field.

export_schema_metadata.command_field_layout: Command fields other than type are copied unchanged from native payload.item; started_at_ms and completed_at_ms are copied unchanged from the enclosing native payload. Layout is flattened by the prior exporter.
export_schema_metadata.record_wrapper: source_line, source_record_sha256, category and the association of turn_id are exporter index metadata; timestamp is copied from the native record.

legacy_index_gaps_satisfied_by_existing_: protocol_harness final listed absent in table
source_intake final listed absent in table
limitations: A local matching hash establishes consistency, not independent provider attestation.
No original workspace record, source file, repository or CSAW artifact modified.
No experiment/test reruns and no model calls.
